archetype_1_stomp_clap_action_rock.vo_structure: 4-Beat Continuous or 1-Gap Split: Greeting (0.0..3.5s) -> [1.2s Crash Gap] -> Escalation Promise (4.8..13.5s) -> [1.2s Crash Gap] -> Launch CTA ('Let's roll!' / 'Let's jump into it!' / 'Let's go!') -> Warning Card (18.0..20.5s)
archetype_1_stomp_clap_action_rock.hook_loop_rule: Cold-Open Clip #1 (0.00s..2.00s) is replayed in full as Body Clip #1 (TLS #353 at 20.4s) or Body Clip #3-#5 (TMax #480 at 61.3s, Bzac Global #397 at 61.4s).

visual_packaging.captions: Komika Axis / Bold Italic Comic at bottom-center [0.50, 0.88], alternating Yellow / Pink / Cyan with thick black stroke
visual_packaging.pillarbox_sidebars: Static textured sidebars with repeating channel logo + top-right 'REC 🔴' indicator
visual_packaging.safety_disclaimer: *NO ONE WAS HURT* / *NO SERIOUS INJURIES* / *he is fine* at bottom-right or bottom-center

archetype_2_cctv_clause_weaving.vo_structure: 6-Clause Call-and-Response Weaving (1.1s..2.9s pure CCTV crash window between every short clause): Greeting ('Good day, folks!') -> [2.9s Crash] -> Hook ('We've got some unexpected moments caught on camera today.') -> [2.0s Crash] -> Category A ('From DIY fails...') -> [1.2s Crash] -> Category B ('...to painful mishaps.') -> [1.3s Crash] -> Retention ('Let's see who made today's list.') -> [1.1s Crash] -> Launch ('Let's go!')

visual_packaging.hook_loop_rule: Clip #1 at 0.00s (bridge demolition) is replayed in full at 34.0s (Body Clip #2).

source_reference.raw_transcript: Hello everyone! We are back with a fresh batch of chaos, fails, and massive regrets that will turn your day around. Grab a seat because everything is about to go wrong. Let's get it on!

six_secret_sauce_rules.1_five_spurt_six_gap_audio_weaving: Slice Track A2 Intro VO into 5 vocal spurts separated by 6 Crash Gaps (Gap #1: 1.80s after greeting; Gap #2: 1.00s visual / 0.44s VO pause after 'OF CHAOS,'; Gap #3: 0.68s visual / 0.80s VO pause after 'FAILS,'; Gap #4: 0.70s full silence after Sentence 1; Gap #5: 0.87s full silence before CTA; Gap #6: 1.02s full silence after CTA before Warning). Unmask Track A1 to 0 dB (or -5..-10 dB on micro-gaps) during every gap.
six_secret_sauce_rules.2_sub_scene_caption_blanking: Track V8 Komika Axis phrase cards MUST terminate at the exact frame physical impact begins (Part B crash window). Never leave text overlays sitting over the frame during explosions or high-velocity impacts (S01b, S04b, S05b, S09, S13, S14b).
six_secret_sauce_rules.3_semantic_visual_lyric_sync: Map teaser clips semantically to the spoken words on Track A2/V8: 'OF CHAOS' -> explosion/fireball; 'FAILS' -> head-smash/slapstick; 'AND MASSIVE REGRETS' -> groin impact on pole/rail; 'TURN YOUR DAY AROUND' -> car/dashcam collision; 'GRAB A SEAT' -> chair/ledge wipeout; 'IS ABOUT TO GO WRONG' -> massive tire/equipment explosion; 'LET'S GET IT ON / STARTED' -> 1st-person POV motorcycle/camera crash.
six_secret_sauce_rules.4_setup_to_impact_internal_jump_cut: For dashcam/CCTV clips requiring context (S07 -> S08), place a 0.50s (12f @ 23.976fps) calm setup slice immediately followed by an internal jump-cut into the 1.00s-1.10s (24-27f) crash slice of the same source clip, while keeping a single continuous Track V8 caption card spanning across the jump-cut.
six_secret_sauce_rules.5_three_point_impact_zoom_transitions: Keep all 12 internal montage cuts between S02 and S14 as razor-sharp Hard Cuts. Apply AE.AE_Impact_Warp / AE.Impact_Cross_Zoom (8-10 frames) strictly at 3 structural boundaries: (1) End of Cold-Open Teaser #1b (f_c2_start), (2) Entry into Warning card (warning_start), and (3) Exit from Warning card into Main Body Clip #1 (warning_end).
six_secret_sauce_rules.6_teaser_4_payoff_bridge_loop: Place the climax explosion of Main Body Clip #1 (itv.kb*.1.mp4) at Teaser #4 (S04a + S04b on 'OF CHAOS'), cutting away right as the subject hits the ground to create an open curiosity loop. Reserve Final Teaser (S14a + S14b) for a 1st-person POV camera-hit jump-scare that triggers the Warning card, then immediately resolve Teaser #4 by playing the full 4-Beat clip (itv.kb*.1.mp4) as Body Clip #1.

failside290_ni4ecuy7duk_hyper15.preset_name: FailSide Moment #290 (NI4ECuy7DUk) — 15-Clip Hyper-Montage & Clean-Screen Camera-Hit Intro Preset

source_reference.episode_title: TOTAL IDIOTS AT WORK #290 | Instant Regret Fails Compilation 2026 | Best of the Month
source_reference.raw_transcript: Hello everyone! We've gathered some of the funniest fails this week, from slip-ups, painful regrets, to bozo disasters guaranteed for you to drop jaws. Let's dive right in!

core_distinctions_vs_bzac189.1_zero_caption_clean_screen_option: FailSide Moment #290 uses ZERO text captions during the entire intro (0.00s..16.08s) so the viewer's eye locks 100% onto the rapid-fire physical action. (When adapted to ITV Moments, can either run Clean-Screen or use compact V8 Komika Axis with Caption Blanking).
core_distinctions_vs_bzac189.2_hyper_15_clip_density: Packs 15 distinct clips into 16.08s (mean 1.07s/clip; middle 13 clips are 0.53s..0.90s each = 13f..21f @ 23.976fps), creating a 30% faster visual cut rate than Bzac New #189.
core_distinctions_vs_bzac189.3_nature_shock_cold_open_347s: Clip #1 (0.00s..3.47s) is a 3.47s force-of-nature shock clip: 1.80s calm palm trees under 'Hello everyone!' -> 1.67s massive lightning bolt striking the palm tree at 1.97s with blinding white flash + camera drop -> Impact Cross Zoom at 3.47s.
core_distinctions_vs_bzac189.4_camera_hit_snowboard_finale_250s: Final Teaser #15 (13.58s..16.08s, 2.50s) is a direct-into-lens collision: 1.06s snowboarder approaching camera under 'Let's dive right in!' (13.14s..14.64s) -> 1.44s unmasked crash gap where the snowboarder slams directly into the cameraman at 15.60s..16.08s (Peak -2.0 dB).
core_distinctions_vs_bzac189.5_acoustic_vacuum_ember_warning_card: During the WARNING! card (16.08s..17.72s, 1.64s with animated fire embers), audio drops to near-total silence (-37 dB to -68 dB) — creating an acoustic vacuum before Body Clip #1 hits.
core_distinctions_vs_bzac189.6_heavy_vehicle_ escalation_at_body_star: Instead of replaying an intro clip at Body Clip #1, FailSide Moment opens the main body (17.72s..35.0s) with 3 consecutive brand-new heavy-vehicle/industrial disasters (runaway dump truck crashing parked cars -> raised dump bed hitting highway gantry -> semi-truck wind rollover).

u_shaped_3anchor_vo_placement.preset_name: U-Shaped 3-Anchor Body VO Placement (Bzac New #189 & FailSide Moment #290 1:1 Standard)
u_shaped_3anchor_vo_placement.core_philosophy: Eliminate dead-center 45%-55% VO placement. Anchor every Body VO either flush to the clip head (Anchor A: Cold-Start Lead-In at +0.18s..0.48s before impact) or flush to the clip tail (Anchor B: Tail-Flush Aftermath Roast ending 0.18s..0.48s before scene cut after impact), leaving the middle crash zone 100% open for raw Track A1 camera audio.

real_impact_detection_spec.stage_1_acoustic_rms_and_flux: Decode 16kHz mono PCM via FFmpeg over [in_sec, in_sec + clip_dur]. Compute 50ms window RMS energy and positive onset spectral flux above 300ms local baseline across [0.15s .. dur - 0.15s].
real_impact_detection_spec.stage_2_visual_motion_fallback: If audio stream is silent/flat (peak RMS <= 0.012 or dynamic crest ratio < 1.35), compute center-crop (12%-88% H, 30%-70% W) frame-to-frame pixel MAD at ~10fps to locate physical climax.
forbidden_patterns: NEVER return hardcoded round(dur * 0.48, 2) or round(dur * 0.45, 2) when media file exists.
NEVER use blind rotating modulo ratio arrays like [0.22, 0.35, 0.48, 0.62, 0.74] to fake impact_sec.

anchor_A_cold_start_lead_in.trigger_condition: t_impact >= vo_dur + 0.40s (impact occurs in second half of clip or after setup window) or VO text is setup/premise
anchor_A_cold_start_lead_in.start_offset_formula: head_anchor in [0.18s .. 0.48s] right at clip start (or immediately after 9-frame TV Static transition)
anchor_A_cold_start_lead_in.end_clearance_rule: vo_end <= t_impact - 0.20s (leaves 1.5s..11.0s tail completely open for raw crash audio on Track A1)
competitor_examples: QDwurG8gJ50 VO#02 (132.60s): StartOff=0.00s after TV Static, finishes 0.81s before beer crates collapse
QDwurG8gJ50 VO#07 (298.62s): StartOff=+0.66s after TV Static, leaves 4.40s tail for crane concrete drop on car
NI4ECuy7DUk VO#21 (463.92s): StartOff=0.00s on 15.79s clip, leaves 11.19s open for full gas station action

anchor_B_tail_flush_aftermath_roast.trigger_condition: t_impact < clip_dur * 0.50 and clip_dur - (t_impact + 0.35s) >= vo_dur + 0.15s (impact occurs early in clip)
anchor_B_tail_flush_aftermath_roast.start_offset_formula: max(t_impact + 0.35s, clip_dur - vo_dur - tail_margin) where tail_margin in [0.18s .. 0.48s]
anchor_B_tail_flush_aftermath_roast.end_clearance_rule: EndRem = 0.18s .. 0.48s before scene cut (punchline finishes flush with clip cut or TV Static trigger)
competitor_examples: QDwurG8gJ50 VO#11 (459.10s): Impact at +3.5s, VO enters at +3.95s, finishes 0.28s before TV Static cut
QDwurG8gJ50 VO#13 (515.33s): VO finishes at EndRem=0.00s right on scene cut
NI4ECuy7DUk VO#08 (198.01s): Mud slip at +2.10s, VO enters at +2.75s, finishes flush at EndRem=0.00s

anchor_C_long_clip_pre_climax_bridge.trigger_condition: Long multi-phase clip (clip_dur >= 11.5s) where t_impact >= vo_dur + 5.5s and text is not an immediate cold-start hook
anchor_C_long_clip_pre_climax_bridge.start_offset_formula: max(0.20s, t_impact - vo_dur - 0.35s) — bridges the build-up right before the climax while leaving >= 2.4s tail for the crash
competitor_examples: QDwurG8gJ50 VO#01 (102.09s on 16.95s clip): StartOff=+6.66s, finishes 5.89s before end
QDwurG8gJ50 VO#04 (184.04s on 13.38s clip): StartOff=+6.23s, finishes 2.41s before end

pacing_and_sequencing_rules.first_body_vo_breathing_room: Never place a Body VO on Main Body Clip #1..#3 right after the Warning card. Start Body VO #1 at Clip #4..#6 (~35s..45s into the video).
pacing_and_sequencing_rules.tv_static_combo_rule: When a 9-frame TV Static transition (V10/A8) precedes a VO clip, prefer Anchor A (Cold-Start Lead-In at +0.18s..0.38s) to create a sharp chapter-reset hook.
pacing_and_sequencing_rules.part2_vo_window_slicing_rule: When trimming a non-note Part 2 clip that carries a Body VO, slice [in_point_sec, out_point_sec] around raw_impact_sec: either place raw_impact_sec near the tail (for Anchor A Cold-Start VO) or at 1.2s..1.6s from clip start (for Anchor B Tail-Flush VO). Never slice blindly at 35%-45% of raw duration.
pacing_and_sequencing_rules.track_v5_mogrt_subtitle_sync: 100% start, end, and duration sync with Track A2 VO. Because VOs are placed at Anchor A (head) or Anchor B (tail), V5 subtitles automatically clear the screen during the physical impact frame.
